tier.Blocked.title: Blocked: this message is dangerous
tier.Blocked.body: We blocked this email because it is very likely a phishing attempt or other threat. Do not open attachments or click any links.
tier.HighRisk.title: High risk: do not act on this email
tier.HighRisk.body: This email shows strong signs of impersonation, fraud, or account compromise. Verify the sender out-of-band before taking any action.
tier.Warning.title: Warning: this email looks suspicious
tier.Warning.body: This email contains signs that someone may be trying to deceive you. Check the sender carefully before clicking links or replying.
tier.Caution.title: Caution: unusual sender or content
tier.Caution.body: Something about this email is unusual. Treat any links, attachments, or requests with care.
tier.Informational.title: First-time external sender
tier.Informational.body: This is the first email we've seen from this sender. Confirm their identity before acting on any requests.
tier.Trusted.title: Trusted sender
tier.Trusted.body: This message comes from a sender your organisation already trusts. No action required.
category.FIRST_CONTACT_EXTERNAL: First contact from outside your organisation
banner.degraded: Some detection services were unavailable during evaluation.
